Rule content: The number of lines between FORM and ENDFORM must not exceed 500.
Programs must not retrieve and display more than 20,000 lines.
Batch input programs should not be used.
A BAPI-based solution should be used in priority.
Search help must be used for all select-options and parameters when a unique list of values exists.

Rule content: All identified objects must be locked using lock object functions before any update.

Rule content: If any required object is already locked, all updates must be stopped or failed.

Rule content: Objects must be created or updated only after all locks are successfully acquired.

Rule content: All locked objects must be unlocked after processing is completed.
Standard number ranges (transaction SNRO) must be used when a specification defines an increment field without describing the technical method to determine the next value.
Logical filenames must be used when a filename is provided by the user.
Special characters must be removed from user-provided filenames before use.
Filename and path checks must be performed to prevent access outside the application scope.
Transaction FILE must be used to manage file paths instead of hard-coded paths.
Transaction FILE must be used to define logical paths and logical filenames.
File upload and download must be restricted to authorized application paths and accepted file types.
System-specific CASE logic for file paths must be avoided.

Rule: Access to data from other application
Rule content: Access to data belonging to another project must be formally requested from the owning project through a service.

Rule: Access to data from other application
Rule content: When accessing standard SAP data (e.g. materials, BOMs), access must be provided via a standard BAPI.
All development must be assigned to a dedicated package following the naming convention ZZ<APPLICATION_CODE><FREE>
Project B must not directly use objects (tables, classes, function modules, etc.) of Project A.
Project A must expose interfaces (API, function module, class, etc.) for its objects.
Project B must use only the exposed interfaces from Project A.
